before: The summary was shown in the previous reply: every Monday 8:00 am, 3 LinkedIn drafts about hiring, they wait for your yes, uses credits each run.

arguments.name: Weekly LinkedIn, hiring
arguments.goal: 3 LinkedIn drafts about hiring every Monday
arguments.instructions: 3 LinkedIn drafts about hiring every Monday. Never invent facts, numbers, prices or dates.

steps.why: The time zone is required and has no fallback. Accounts are bound as objects. Ask me first unless the user said post without asking. Monthly runs on the 1st; any other day of the month is a cron.
Switching on is not running. Nothing is written until the next run.
next_run_at is UTC: say it in the brand's clock. Only now say it is on.

say: Bolta routine on. First drafts Mon Nov 16, 8:00 am (New York). On Monday, say 'what's waiting'.
never: run-routine-now in the same breath: it spends credits and needs its own yes.
A bare 'routine' where the app's own scheduling could be meant.
